candidates.name: Spinal epidural abscess
support_spans: difficulty with urination
Contrast-enhanced thoracic magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated an inflammatory lesion of the T9 lamina and a posterior epidural abscess compressing the spinal cord at T9–T10
candidates.why: The patient developed weakness and numbness in both legs and difficulty with urination, and imaging studies showed a posterior epidural abscess compressing the spinal cord.

candidates.name: Osteomyelitis
support_spans: progressive back pain

candidates.why: The patient had progressive back pain and imaging studies showed osteolytic destruction of the neural arch of T9, consistent with osteomyelitis.
